title: Canonical Formula Rank Consensus

formula_sample.selection: fixed deterministic sample; no outcome-based selection
formula_sample.weighting: one vote per unique canonical formula ID; alias multiplicity does not increase weight
formula_sample.universe_scope: sample only; not exhaustive over 9,808,263 canonical formulas

hypothesis: Rank consensus across algebraically distinct formula samples improves number ranking versus equal-family and equal-feature controls.

policies.definition: ascending rank of mean formula rank across 113 unique canonical formulas
ascending rank of median formula rank across 113 unique canonical formulas
descending count of formula Top-5 votes; ties by mean rank then ascending number

limitations: 113-formula deterministic sample, not exhaustive formula universe
formula ranks are dependent due shared features
historical Blind OOS is exposed, not virgin prospective evidence
Holm correction applies only to this preregistered family, not Q00-Q141
next_action: If no robust consensus lift is found, do not tune on Blind OOS; prioritize durable Q90 AST import and Q7 typed-output integration.
